{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display the first few rows and basic info
display(trial.head())
display(trial.info())

# Check for missing values in the key columns
baseline_missing = trial['baseline_biomarker'].isnull().sum()
followup_missing = trial['followup_biomarker'].isnull().sum()

print(f"Missing baseline: {baseline_missing}")
print(f"Missing follow-up: {followup_missing}")"}
